briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A surge in Minnesota fraud cases has been uncovered, including a $250 million charity fraud case linked to Ilhan Omar. The investigation reveals that Omar's name came up six times in the case after she loosened oversight of fed funded food programs. Additionally, whistleblowers have testified on Minnesota child care fraud, linking money to terrorist groups. These findings suggest a potential connection between Ilhan Omar and the charity fraud case, warranting further investigation. The Minnesota Attorney General's office is actively investigating these cases, and the FBI is also involved in some of the probes.
